lines.t: It is the one who endures through the pain,
Pressing forward though winds may rage,
Through every trial, they stand again,
Their heart beats strong upon the stage.
When the shadows fall and the road grows cold,
They find their strength in the stories told.
For it is the one who finishes the race,
Who holds their faith, who keeps the pace.
Yet the soul who surrenders all to the Lord,
Will rise above, forever restored.
They will fly, fly with eagle’s wings,
Lifted high by the King of kings.
Every tear, every scar, every flame,
Refines the spirit, shapes the name.
Through every storm, theirheart proclaims,
Hope remains, it never wanes.
Oh, when the weight feels too much to bear,
They lift their eyes, and find mercy there.
In the hands of grace, they’re not alone,
The broken made whole, the lost made known.
For it is the one who finishes the race,
Who holds their faith, who keeps the pace.
Yet the soul who surrenders all to the Lord,
Will rise above, forever restored.
They will fly, fly with eagle’s wings,
Lifted high by the King of kings.
Endure the pain, let faith remain,
For victory sings in heaven’s refrain.
They will fly, fly with eagle’s wings.
